title: AI PM Learning Roadmap
summary: The article presents a structured self-learning roadmap for becoming an AI Product Manager, covering nine key areas including prompt engineering, RAG, AI prototyping, agent workflows, and evals. The author argues that AI PM is a subset of traditional PM but requires greater technical depth, heavier use of AI tools, and the ability to build and evaluate AI-specific features. The roadmap is positioned as a free alternative to expensive paid courses, curating tools, frameworks, and guides across each competency area.
key_claims: AI PM is a subset of traditional PM, but requires greater technical depth and higher expectation of AI tool use than conventional product management.
Prompt engineering is described as the number-one skill for building great agents and improving productivity.
RAG should be used when retrieving specific knowledge or documents, fine-tuning for specialized domains with consistent style needs, and prompting for simple or general tasks.
Common mistakes when building AI products include having no fallback strategy, ignoring latency and cost, building without evaluations, and overfitting to demos.

Breaking into AI PM requires building a portfolio, updating a resume and LinkedIn, obtaining referrals, and being over-prepared for unique interview formats including vibe coding and AI ethics questions.
